# Navigato

> MIT travel-booking React library (`@navigato/react`). Index only — not a teacher. Query DESIGN.md and the component registry in the GitHub repo before any prop. Never emit `@/components/ui` from memory.

## System

- [Getting started](/nvgto-styleguide/getting-started/): install `@navigato/react`
- [Accessibility](/nvgto-styleguide/getting-started/accessibility/): what consumers must still do
- [Tokens — color](/nvgto-styleguide/tokens/colors/)
- [Tokens — type](/nvgto-styleguide/tokens/typography/)
- DESIGN.md and AGENTS.md live at the repo root (quality bar + agent rules). They are not HTML pages.
